security_audit.summary: All 52 static detections are false positives caused by Markdown links, Markdown code delimiters, workspace-path documentation, and repository homepage metadata. The skill contains explicit untrusted-input guidance and does not include executable commands, network requests, credential access, prompt injection, or data-exfiltration instructions.

remediation.issue: Automated scanners misclassify Markdown paths and code delimiters as dangerous operations.
remediation.suggestion: Use scanner rules that distinguish Markdown links and inline code from executable shell or filesystem operations.

content.value_statement: Product feeds can lose visibility through disapprovals, missing attributes, and incorrect product data. This skill creates a structured remediation plan for titles, attributes, identifiers, prices, availability, and listing groups.
actual_capabilities: Triages product disapprovals into named causes and proposed fixes.
Checks required and recommended feed attributes for completeness.
Rewrites titles using front-loaded, product-specific attribute patterns.
Flags GTIN, price, availability, and landing-page mismatches.
Suggests listing-group and asset-group structures based on real feed fields.
Marks missing source data instead of inventing product facts.
limitations: It needs a feed export, diagnostics, or product details to audit specific items.
It cannot confirm live platform policies or landing-page content without provided access or data.
It does not publish feed changes or push updates to advertising platforms.
It does not replace legal, policy, or product-data review.

use_cases.title: Repair Merchant Center disapprovals
use_cases.description: Review a diagnostics export, identify each disapproval cause, and prepare a per-item remediation plan.

use_cases.title: Improve catalog titles and attributes
use_cases.description: Apply truthful title patterns and identify missing attributes before a Shopping campaign launch.

use_cases.title: Plan feed-driven campaign groups
use_cases.description: Organize approved products into practical listing groups or asset groups using real catalog fields.

prompt_templates.title: Check one product
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this product record for missing Shopping feed attributes and list the most important fixes: [paste product record].

prompt_templates.title: Triage disapprovals
prompt_templates.prompt: Triage this Merchant Center diagnostics export. Create a table with item, cause, evidence needed, and proposed fix: [paste export].

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite catalog titles
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite these product titles using truthful front-loaded attributes. Preserve only facts supported by each product record and flag missing facts: [paste records].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a PMax feed plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this feed and diagnostics export for a Performance Max launch. Prioritize disapprovals, propose title and attribute fixes, and recommend listing groups using existing feed fields: [attach data].

output_examples.input: A product has a missing GTIN and its feed price differs from the landing page.
output: Cause: missing product identifier and price mismatch.
Action: obtain the real GTIN from the manufacturer and verify the landing-page price before updating the feed.
Status: keep the item flagged until source data is confirmed.

output_examples.input: A generic shoe title includes promotional language and lacks variant attributes.
output: Suggested title: Brand + running shoe + key specification + color + size.
Remove promotional wording from the title.
Add only verified brand, color, size, and identifier values.

best_practices: Provide the original feed export and current diagnostics together.
Verify all rewritten facts against product records and landing pages.
Resolve disapprovals before investing in title refinement or campaign grouping.
anti_patterns: Do not invent GTINs, prices, stock levels, brands, or product specifications.
Do not treat a polished title as a fix for a disapproved product.
Do not overwrite feed prices or availability without confirming the source of truth.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a feed export, platform diagnostics, and product or landing-page details when available.

faq.question: Can this skill fix Merchant Center disapprovals?
faq.answer: It identifies likely causes and proposes fixes, but a user must verify and apply the changes.

faq.question: Does it invent missing GTINs?
faq.answer: No. It flags missing identifiers as needing a verified source.

faq.question: Can it rewrite product titles?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests truthful, front-loaded titles based on supplied product attributes.

faq.question: Can it publish changes to my feed?
faq.answer: No. It prepares recommendations and does not publish feed changes.

faq.question: Does it work for Performance Max?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recommend feed-driven listing groups and asset-group structures.
